source.description: Default download location, fetched on demand by install_test_orchestrator_agent: the Digital.ai sample repository, pinned to an immutable commit and verified by SHA-256. To move to a permanent production location, update downloadUrl + sha256 here, or set TEST_ORCHESTRATOR_JAR_URL + TEST_ORCHESTRATOR_JAR_SHA256 at runtime.

requirements.java: 17 or 21 (Java 25 support is in progress upstream)
